baseline.model:
---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC

CONSTANTS Recording, OtherRecording, MaxAttempts, MaxDifferences, MaxCleanupAttempts

VARIABLES outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed

vars == <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Names are abstract path components; prefix is prepended to name by the caller.
HiddenName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> ".", name |-> Recording]
FinalName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
SpoolName == [directory |-> "spool", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
OtherName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> OtherRecording]
Names == {HiddenName, FinalName, SpoolName, OtherName}
Kinds == {"none", "compareNamed", "copy", "compareHidden", "publish", "removeHidden", "removeSpool"}
Phases == {"idle", "inspect", "inspectTaken", "preclean", "copy", "verify", "discard", "publish", "retention", "terminal"}
Reasons == {"none", "folderGone", "folderFull", "nameConflict", "differentCopies"}
Replies == {"none", "ok", "absent", "same", "different", "taken", "folderGone", "folderFull", "removeFailed"}
NoRequest == [kind |-> "none", target |-> HiddenName, token |-> <<0, 0, "idle", 0>>]
Request(kind, target, stage) ==
    [kind |-> kind, target |-> target, token |-> <<attempt, round, stage, cleanupTry>>]
Requests ==
    [kind : Kinds, target : Names,
     token : (0..MaxAttempts) \X (0..MaxDifferences) \X Phases \X (0..MaxCleanupAttempts)]
Terminal == outcome \in {"handedOver", "failed"}
FolderMutation(r) == r.kind \in {"copy", "publish", "removeHidden"}

\* The ratified contract is about requests and durable evidence, not disk code.
PublicationIsVerified ==
    /\ (intent.kind = "publish" \/ wire.kind = "publish") => hiddenVerified
    /\ publications > 0 => publicationVerified /\ named = "same"

SpoolRemovalIsSafe ==
    (intent.kind = "removeSpool" \/ wire.kind = "removeSpool" \/ ~spool)
        => outcome = "handedOver" /\ namedVerified /\ keepElapsed

NoCopyAfterPublication ==
    publications > 0 => intent.kind # "copy" /\ wire.kind # "copy"

OneCopyAtATime == activeCopies <= 1

ReplayKeepsIdentity ==
    /\ wire = NoRequest \/ wire = intent
    /\ caller # "idle" => execution = intent

OnlyOwnedNames ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} :
        /\ FolderMutation(r) => r.target \in {HiddenName, FinalName}
        /\ r.kind \in {"copy", "removeHidden"} => r.target = HiddenName
        /\ r.kind = "publish" => r.target = FinalName
        /\ r.kind = "removeSpool" => r.target = SpoolName

CopiesAreHidden ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} : r.kind = "copy" => r.target.prefix = "."

NewCopiesStartCleanly ==
    (intent.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle") => hidden = "absent"

DifferenceLimitStopsCopying ==
    differences = MaxDifferences /\ outcome = "active" => phase = "discard"

AtMostOnePublication == publications <= 1

ForeignFileIsPreserved == foreignContent # "absent" => named = foreignContent /\ publications = 0

SuccessHasEvidence == outcome = "handedOver" => named = "same" /\ namedVerified

FailureKeepsSpool == outcome = "failed" => spool /\ reason \in (Reasons \ {"none"})

DifferentCopyIsNotPublished == hidden = "different" => ~hiddenVerified

DifferenceLimitCleansUp == reason = "differentCopies" => differences = MaxDifferences /\ hidden = "absent"

ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy == initialNamed = "same" => copies = 0

CleanupCannotUndoDelivery == cleanup # "dormant" => outcome = "handedOver"

TypeOK ==
    /\ Recording # OtherRecording
    /\ MaxAttempts \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxDifferences \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxCleanupAttempts \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ outcome \in {"notStarted", "active", "handedOver", "failed"}
    /\ phase \in Phases /\ reason \in Reasons
    /\ attempt \in 0..MaxAttempts /\ round \in 0..MaxDifferences /\ differences \in 0..MaxDifferences
    /\ cleanup \in {"dormant", "waiting", "active", "failed", "done"}
    /\ cleanupReason \in {"none", "removeFailed"} /\ cleanupTry \in 0..MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ intent \in Requests /\ wire \in Requests /\ execution \in Requests
    /\ caller \in {"idle", "busy", "done"} /\ reply \in Replies
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ named \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ foreignContent \in {"absent", "same", "different"} /\ initialNamed \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ hiddenVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ namedVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ publicationVerified \in BOOLEAN
    /\ publications \in 0..2 /\ copies \in 0..(MaxAttempts * MaxDifferences)
    /\ activeCopies \in 0..2 /\ spool \in BOOLEAN /\ keepElapsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ running \in BOOLEAN /\ replayed \in BOOLEAN

DeliveredByCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ spool
AcceptedExisting == outcome = "handedOver" /\ initialNamed = "same" /\ copies = 0
ConflictingName == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "nameConflict" /\ named = "different"
FolderGone == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderGone"
FolderFull == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderFull"
DifferencesExhausted == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "differentCopies" /\ hidden = "absent"
ReplacedDifferentCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ round > 1 /\ publications = 1
RetriedDelivery == outcome = "handedOver" /\ attempt > 1
RecoveredPublication == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ replayed
RetainingOriginal == outcome = "handedOver" /\ spool /\ ~keepElapsed
OriginalRemoved == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ ~spool
CleanupFailed == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ spool
CleanupRetried == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ cleanupTry > 1

\* No fairness is imposed on the caller or the passage of retention time.
\* A caller that never resumes or never supplies an outstanding result has
\* interrupted the hand-over for good, and is outside this progress promise.
CallerContinues == ([]<>running) /\ ((intent # NoRequest) ~> (caller = "done"))
StartedAttemptFinishes == CallerContinues => ((outcome = "active") ~> Terminal)

Init ==
    /\ outcome = "notStarted" /\ phase = "idle" /\ reason = "none"
    /\ attempt = 0 /\ round = 0 /\ differences = 0
    /\ cleanup = "dormant" /\ cleanupReason = "none" /\ cleanupTry = 0
    /\ intent = NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest /\ caller = "idle" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ hidden = "absent" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ foreignContent = named /\ initialNamed = named
    /\ hiddenVerified = FALSE /\ namedVerified = FALSE /\ publicationVerified = FALSE
    /\ publications = 0 /\ copies = 0 /\ activeCopies = 0
    /\ spool = TRUE /\ keepElapsed = FALSE /\ running = TRUE /\ replayed = FALSE
    /\ execution = NoRequest

\* Start and retry are caller choices; attempts are bounded only for exploration.
Start ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "notStarted"
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ phase' = "inspect" /\ attempt' = 1 /\ round' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reason, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryDelivery ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "failed" /\ attempt < MaxAttempts
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ reason' = "none" /\ attempt' = attempt + 1
    /\ round' = 1 /\ differences' = 0 /\ hiddenVerified' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = IF hidden = "absent" THEN "inspect" ELSE "preclean"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named,
                   foreignContent, initialNamed, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Issue ==
    /\ running /\ intent = NoRequest /\ (outcome = "active" \/ cleanup = "active")
    /\ LET r == CASE phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} -> Request("compareNamed", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "preclean" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "copy" -> Request("copy", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "verify" -> Request("compareHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "discard" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "publish" -> Request("publish", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "retention" -> Request("removeSpool", SpoolName, phase)
       IN intent' = r /\ wire' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Resend ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ wire' = intent
    /\ replayed' = (replayed \/ (intent.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "ok"))
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The caller adapter executes an identity once, caches its result, and shares
\* an in-flight copy with all repetitions. These are the settled caller rules.
BeginCopy ==
    /\ wire.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "busy" /\ hidden' = "partial" /\ activeCopies' = 1 /\ copies' = copies + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, reply, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

FinishCopy(result, content) ==
    /\ caller = "busy"
    /\ result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
    /\ content \in IF result = "ok" THEN {"same", "different"} ELSE {"partial"}
    /\ reply' = result /\ hidden' = content
    /\ caller' = "done" /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

ExecuteOther(r) ==
    /\ wire # NoRequest /\ wire.kind # "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "done"
    /\ r \in CASE wire.kind = "compareNamed" -> {named, "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "compareHidden" -> {hidden, "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "publish" -> {IF named = "absent" THEN "ok" ELSE "taken", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "removeHidden" -> {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "removeSpool" -> {"ok", "removeFailed"}
    /\ reply' = r
    /\ hidden' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind \in {"publish", "removeHidden"} THEN "absent" ELSE hidden
    /\ named' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hidden ELSE named
    /\ publications' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN publications + 1 ELSE publications
    /\ publicationVerified' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hiddenVerified ELSE publicationVerified
    /\ spool' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "removeSpool" THEN FALSE ELSE spool
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, copies, activeCopies, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

Consume ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = intent /\ caller = "done"
    /\ intent' = NoRequest /\ wire' = NoRequest /\ caller' = "idle" /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ LET failed == reply \in {"folderGone", "folderFull"}
           success == (phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "same") \/ (phase = "publish" /\ reply = "ok")
           conflict == phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "different"
           exhausted == phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ differences = MaxDifferences
       IN /\ outcome' = IF phase = "retention" THEN outcome
                         ELSE IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted THEN "failed"
                         ELSE IF success THEN "handedOver" ELSE outcome
          /\ reason' = IF failed THEN reply ELSE IF conflict THEN "nameConflict"
                        ELSE IF exhausted THEN "differentCopies" ELSE reason
          /\ phase' = IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted \/ success \/ phase = "retention" THEN "terminal"
                       ELSE CASE phase = "inspect" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "preclean" -> "inspect"
                                 [] phase = "copy" -> "verify"
                                 [] phase = "verify" -> IF reply = "same" THEN "publish" ELSE "discard"
                                 [] phase = "discard" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "publish" -> "inspectTaken"
          /\ differences' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "different" THEN differences + 1 ELSE differences
          /\ round' = IF phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ ~exhausted THEN round + 1 ELSE round
          /\ hiddenVerified' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "same" THEN TRUE
                                ELSE IF phase \in {"preclean", "discard"} /\ reply = "ok" THEN FALSE
                                ELSE hiddenVerified
          /\ namedVerified' = (namedVerified \/ success)
          /\ cleanup' = IF success THEN "waiting"
                         ELSE IF phase = "retention" THEN IF reply = "ok" THEN "done" ELSE "failed"
                         ELSE cleanup
          /\ cleanupReason' = IF phase = "retention" /\ reply = "removeFailed" THEN "removeFailed" ELSE cleanupReason
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempt, cleanupTry, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = NoRequest

BeginRetention ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "waiting" /\ keepElapsed
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupTry' = 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanupReason, intent, wire,
                   caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryCleanup ==
    /\ running /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ cleanupTry < MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupReason' = "none" /\ cleanupTry' = cleanupTry + 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The environment may take the final name even between its comparison and
\* publication. Publication is non-replacing and reports that collision.
NameAppears(content) ==
    /\ outcome = "active" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetentionElapsed ==
    /\ ~keepElapsed /\ keepElapsed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Crash ==
    /\ running /\ running' = FALSE /\ wire' = NoRequest
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Resume ==
    /\ ~running /\ running' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* Stopping or waiting for the caller is legitimate and never a deadlock.
Wait == UNCHANGED vars

Drive == Issue \/ Resend \/ Consume \/ BeginRetention
IssueProgress == SF_vars(Issue)
ResendProgress == SF_vars(Resend)
ConsumeProgress == SF_vars(Consume)
RetentionProgress == SF_vars(BeginRetention)

\* Single-root exploration: choose a pre-existing file before starting.
InitialFile(content) ==
    /\ outcome = "notStarted" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content /\ initialNamed' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
                   cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   execution, hidden, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified,
                   publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

Next == Start \/ RetryDelivery \/ Issue \/ Resend \/ Consume \/ BeginRetention \/ BeginCopy
        \/ (\E result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}, content \in {"same", "different", "partial"} : FinishCopy(result, content))
        \/ (\E r \in Replies : ExecuteOther(r))
        \/ RetryCleanup
        \/ (\E content \in {"same", "different"} : NameAppears(content))
        \/ (\E content \in {"same", "different"} : InitialFile(content))
        \/ RetentionElapsed \/ Crash \/ Resume \/ Wait

\* Mutation tests emit the unsafe request, before any file effect is needed.
PublishUnchecked ==
    /\ running /\ phase = "verify" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("publish", FinalName, "publish") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RemoveSpoolEarly ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "active" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("removeSpool", SpoolName, "retention") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication ==
    /\ running /\ intent.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "ok" /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ wire' = Request("copy", HiddenName, "copy")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

CopyWhileBusy ==
    /\ caller = "busy" /\ activeCopies = 1
    /\ activeCopies' = 2
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RemoveUnrelatedFile ==
    /\ running /\ phase = "discard" /\ intent = NoRequest
    /\ intent' = Request("removeHidden", OtherName, "discard") /\ wire' = intent'
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The hand-over starts in its initial state and proceeds through the modeled core and caller steps.

statements.name: PublicationIsVerified
statements.says: The core requests publication only after the hidden copy was found identical to the spool file, and every publication carries that evidence.

statements.name: SpoolRemovalIsSafe
statements.says: The original is requested for removal or removed only after verified delivery and expiry of its retention time.

statements.name: NoCopyAfterPublication
statements.says: Once the recording has been published, the core never requests another copy, including after an interruption before recording success.

statements.name: OneCopyAtATime
statements.says: At most one copy of the recording is being executed at a time.

statements.name: ReplayKeepsIdentity
statements.says: A repeated request retains the saved operation, names and identity, including while its execution or result is outstanding.

statements.name: OnlyOwnedNames
statements.says: Every request to change or remove a file targets only the appropriate hidden name, recording name or original spool file belonging to this hand-over.

statements.name: CopiesAreHidden
statements.says: Every copy request uses the hand-over’s hidden name with a leading dot.

statements.name: NewCopiesStartCleanly
statements.says: A new copy is requested only after any previous hidden copy has been removed.

statements.name: DifferenceLimitStopsCopying
statements.says: Reaching the configured limit of differing copies permits only their cleanup before the attempt finishes.

statements.name: AtMostOnePublication
statements.says: The recording is published at most once across all interruptions and retries.

statements.name: ForeignFileIsPreserved
statements.says: A file already occupying the final name is never replaced or removed by this hand-over.

statements.name: SuccessHasEvidence
statements.says: A successful hand-over has an identical file at its final name and recorded verification evidence.

statements.name: FailureKeepsSpool
statements.says: A failed hand-over records its reason and retains the original spool file.

statements.name: DifferentCopyIsNotPublished
statements.says: A differing hidden copy never carries permission to be published.

statements.name: DifferenceLimitCleansUp
statements.says: An attempt that fails for exhausting its differing-copy limit has removed the last differing copy.

statements.name: ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy
statements.says: An identical file present at the final name when the hand-over begins is accepted without making a copy.

statements.name: CleanupCannotUndoDelivery
statements.says: Waiting for retention, removing the original, or failing and retrying that removal leaves the hand-over successful.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every state component stays within its declared type and exploration bounds.

statements.name: DeliveredByCopy
statements.says: A new copy can be verified and published while the original remains in the spool.

statements.name: AcceptedExisting
statements.says: An identical existing file can be accepted without copying.

statements.name: ConflictingName
statements.says: A differing existing file can cause a name-conflict failure while remaining unchanged.

statements.name: FolderGone
statements.says: A missing folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

statements.name: FolderFull
statements.says: A full folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

statements.name: DifferencesExhausted
statements.says: Repeated differing copies can reach the limit, be cleaned up and produce the specified failure.

statements.name: ReplacedDifferentCopy
statements.says: A differing copy can be removed and replaced by a copy that is successfully handed over.

statements.name: RetriedDelivery
statements.says: A failed hand-over can be retried successfully.

statements.name: RecoveredPublication
statements.says: An interruption after publication but before recording success can be recovered by repeating the original request.

statements.name: RetainingOriginal
statements.says: A successful hand-over can retain its original while the retention time has not elapsed.

statements.name: OriginalRemoved
statements.says: The original can be removed after successful hand-over and expiry of retention.

statements.name: CleanupFailed
statements.says: Removal of the original can fail while the hand-over stays successful and the original remains.

statements.name: CleanupRetried
statements.says: A failed removal of the original can be retried successfully.

statements.name: IssueProgress
statements.says: If issuing the next saved request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually issues it.

statements.name: ResendProgress
statements.says: If repeating an interrupted request is possible repeatedly, the core eventually repeats it.

statements.name: ConsumeProgress
statements.says: If recording a completed caller result is possible repeatedly, the core eventually records it.

statements.name: RetentionProgress
statements.says: If starting original removal after retention is possible repeatedly, the core eventually starts it.

statements.name: StartedAttemptFinishes
statements.says: If execution keeps resuming and the caller eventually answers outstanding requests, each started attempt eventually reports success or failure.

statements.name: PublishUnchecked
statements.says: The core requests publication before comparing the copy.

statements.name: RemoveSpoolEarly
statements.says: The core requests removal of the original before delivery.

statements.name: RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication
statements.says: After an interrupted publication, recovery requests a fresh copy instead of repeating the saved publication request.

statements.name: CopyWhileBusy
statements.says: A second copy is started while the first copy is still in progress.

statements.name: RemoveUnrelatedFile
statements.says: Discarding a differing copy mistakenly requests removal of an unrelated file.

amended.name: DifferenceLimitStopsCopying

amended.name: AtMostOnePublication
amended.says: The recording is published at most once across all interruptions and retries.

amended.name: ForeignFileIsPreserved

amended.name: SuccessHasEvidence

amended.name: FailureKeepsSpool

amended.name: DifferentCopyIsNotPublished
amended.says: A differing hidden copy never carries permission to be published.

amended.name: DifferenceLimitCleansUp
amended.says: An attempt that fails for exhausting its differing-copy limit has removed the last differing copy.

amended.name: ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy
amended.says: An identical file present at the final name when the hand-over begins is accepted without making a copy.

amended.name: CleanupCannotUndoDelivery

amended.name: TypeOK

amended.name: DeliveredByCopy
amended.says: A new copy can be verified and published while the original remains in the spool.

amended.name: AcceptedExisting

amended.name: ConflictingName
amended.says: A differing existing file can cause a name-conflict failure while remaining unchanged.

amended.says: A missing folder can end the hand-over with that failure reason.

amended.name: FolderFull

amended.name: ReplacedDifferentCopy

amended.name: RetriedDelivery
amended.says: A failed hand-over can be retried successfully.

amended.name: RecoveredPublication

amended.name: RetainingOriginal

amended.name: RetentionProgress

amended.name: StartedAttemptFinishes

amended.name: PublishUnchecked

amended.name: RemoveSpoolEarly

amended.name: RestartAfterUnrecordedPublication

amended.name: CopyWhileBusy

model.module_text:
---- MODULE RecordingHandover ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC, Sequences

CONSTANTS Recording, OtherRecording, MaxAttempts, MaxDifferences, MaxCleanupAttempts,
          LegacyReasonMax, LegacyAnswerMax

VARIABLES outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed

vars == <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
          cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution,
          hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
          namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
          spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Names are abstract path components; prefix is prepended to name by the caller.
HiddenName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> ".", name |-> Recording]
FinalName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
SpoolName == [directory |-> "spool", prefix |-> "", name |-> Recording]
OtherName == [directory |-> "folder", prefix |-> "", name |-> OtherRecording]
Names == {HiddenName, FinalName, SpoolName, OtherName}
Kinds == {"none", "compareNamed", "copy", "compareHidden", "publish", "removeHidden", "removeSpool"}
Phases == {"idle", "inspect", "inspectTaken", "preclean", "copy", "verify", "discard", "publish", "retention", "terminal"}
Reasons == {"none", "folderGone", "folderFull", "nameConflict", "differentCopies", "nameFreed", "copyGone"}
Replies == {"none", "ok", "absent", "same", "different", "taken", "folderGone", "folderFull", "removeFailed", "copyGone"}
NoRequest == [kind |-> "none", target |-> HiddenName, token |-> <<0, 0, "idle", 0>>]
Request(kind, target, stage) ==
    [kind |-> kind, target |-> target, token |-> <<attempt, round, stage, cleanupTry>>]
Requests ==
    [kind : Kinds, target : Names,
     token : (0..MaxAttempts) \X (0..MaxDifferences) \X Phases \X (0..MaxCleanupAttempts)]
Terminal == outcome \in {"handedOver", "failed"}
FolderMutation(r) == r.kind \in {"copy", "publish", "removeHidden"}

\* The ratified contract is about requests and durable evidence, not disk code.
PublicationIsVerified ==
    /\ (intent.kind = "publish" \/ wire.kind = "publish") => hiddenVerified
    /\ publications > 0 => publicationVerified /\ named = "same"

SpoolRemovalIsSafe ==
    (intent.kind = "removeSpool" \/ wire.kind = "removeSpool" \/ ~spool)
        => outcome = "handedOver" /\ namedVerified /\ keepElapsed

NoCopyAfterPublication ==
    publications > 0 => intent.kind # "copy" /\ wire.kind # "copy"

OneCopyAtATime == activeCopies <= 1

ReplayKeepsIdentity ==
    /\ wire = NoRequest \/ wire = intent
    /\ caller # "idle" => execution = intent

OnlyOwnedNames ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} :
        /\ FolderMutation(r) => r.target \in {HiddenName, FinalName}
        /\ r.kind \in {"copy", "removeHidden"} => r.target = HiddenName
        /\ r.kind = "publish" => r.target = FinalName
        /\ r.kind = "removeSpool" => r.target = SpoolName

CopiesAreHidden ==
    \A r \in {intent, wire} : r.kind = "copy" => r.target.prefix = "."

NewCopiesStartCleanly ==
    (intent.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle") => hidden = "absent"

DifferenceLimitStopsCopying ==
    differences = MaxDifferences /\ outcome = "active" => phase = "discard"

AtMostOnePublication == publications <= 1

ForeignFileIsPreserved == foreignContent # "absent" => named = foreignContent /\ publications = 0

SuccessHasEvidence == outcome = "handedOver" => named = "same" /\ namedVerified

FailureKeepsSpool == outcome = "failed" => spool /\ reason \in (Reasons \ {"none"})

DifferentCopyIsNotPublished == hidden = "different" => ~hiddenVerified

DifferenceLimitCleansUp == reason = "differentCopies" => differences = MaxDifferences /\ hidden = "absent"

ExistingMatchAvoidsCopy == initialNamed = "same" => copies = 0

CleanupCannotUndoDelivery == cleanup # "dormant" => outcome = "handedOver"

TypeOK ==
    /\ Recording # OtherRecording
    /\ MaxAttempts \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxDifferences \in Nat \ {0} /\ MaxCleanupAttempts \in Nat \ {0}
    /\ outcome \in {"notStarted", "active", "handedOver", "failed"}
    /\ phase \in Phases /\ reason \in Reasons
    /\ attempt \in 0..MaxAttempts /\ round \in 0..MaxDifferences /\ differences \in 0..MaxDifferences
    /\ cleanup \in {"dormant", "waiting", "active", "failed", "done"}
    /\ cleanupReason \in {"none", "removeFailed"} /\ cleanupTry \in 0..MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ intent \in Requests /\ wire \in Requests /\ execution \in Requests
    /\ caller \in {"idle", "busy", "done"} /\ reply \in Replies
    /\ hidden \in {"absent", "partial", "same", "different"}
    /\ named \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ foreignContent \in {"absent", "same", "different"} /\ initialNamed \in {"absent", "same", "different"}
    /\ hiddenVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ namedVerified \in BOOLEAN /\ publicationVerified \in BOOLEAN
    /\ publications \in 0..2 /\ copies \in 0..(MaxAttempts * MaxDifferences)
    /\ activeCopies \in 0..2 /\ spool \in BOOLEAN /\ keepElapsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ running \in BOOLEAN /\ replayed \in BOOLEAN

DeliveredByCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ spool
AcceptedExisting == outcome = "handedOver" /\ initialNamed = "same" /\ copies = 0
ConflictingName == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "nameConflict" /\ named = "different"
FolderGone == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderGone"
FolderFull == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "folderFull"
DifferencesExhausted == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "differentCopies" /\ hidden = "absent"
ReplacedDifferentCopy == outcome = "handedOver" /\ round > 1 /\ publications = 1
RetriedDelivery == outcome = "handedOver" /\ attempt > 1
RecoveredPublication == outcome = "handedOver" /\ publications = 1 /\ replayed
RetainingOriginal == outcome = "handedOver" /\ spool /\ ~keepElapsed
OriginalRemoved == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ ~spool
CleanupFailed == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ spool
CleanupRetried == outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "done" /\ cleanupTry > 1

\* No fairness is imposed on the caller or the passage of retention time.
\* A caller that never resumes or never supplies an outstanding result has
\* interrupted the hand-over for good, and is outside this progress promise.
CallerContinues == ([]<>running) /\ ((intent # NoRequest) ~> (caller = "done"))
StartedAttemptFinishes == CallerContinues => ((outcome = "active") ~> Terminal)

\* Either truthful error may be observed if both names have changed.
PublicationReplies ==
    (IF named # "absent" THEN {"taken"} ELSE {})
    \cup (IF hidden = "absent" THEN {"copyGone"} ELSE {})
    \cup (IF named = "absent" /\ hidden # "absent" THEN {"ok"} ELSE {})
RaceReason ==
    IF phase = "inspectTaken" /\ reply = "absent" THEN "nameFreed"
    ELSE IF phase = "publish" /\ reply = "copyGone" THEN "copyGone" ELSE "none"
OnlyOwnedComparisons ==
    \A request \in {intent, wire} :
        /\ request.kind = "compareNamed" => request.target = FinalName
        /\ request.kind = "compareHidden" => request.target = HiddenName
AbsenceAnswersAreDistinct ==
    /\ reply = "absent" => execution.kind = "compareNamed"
    /\ reply = "copyGone" => execution.kind = "publish"
DisappearanceFailureKeepsOriginal ==
    reason \in {"nameFreed", "copyGone"} => outcome = "failed" /\ phase = "terminal" /\ spool
NameConflictHasDifferentFile == reason = "nameConflict" => named = "different"
FreedNameFailure == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "nameFreed"
MissingCopyFailure == outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "copyGone"
AbsentHiddenComparison ==
    caller = "done" /\ execution.kind = "compareHidden" /\ hidden = "absent" /\ reply = "different"

FreedNameEndsAttempt ==
    CallerContinues => ((outcome = "active" /\ phase = "inspectTaken" /\ caller = "done" /\ reply = "absent")
                       ~> (outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "nameFreed"))
MissingCopyEndsAttempt ==
    CallerContinues => ((outcome = "active" /\ phase = "publish" /\ caller = "done" /\ reply = "copyGone")
                       ~> (outcome = "failed" /\ reason = "copyGone"))

\* The environment can free a collision before the requested comparison.
\* Removal after a successful named comparison/publication is outside this issue.
NameFreed ==
    /\ outcome = "active" /\ phase = "inspectTaken" /\ caller # "done"
    /\ named # "absent" /\ publications = 0
    /\ named' = "absent" /\ foreignContent' = "absent"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution, hidden, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Deletion can happen after copying or even after verification, also while
\* interrupted; historical verification does not make a missing file publishable.
HiddenCopyRemoved ==
    /\ outcome = "active" /\ publications = 0 /\ hidden # "absent" /\ caller # "busy"
    /\ hidden' = "absent"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, execution, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Hypothetical: falsely accept an absent collision as an existing match.
FreedNameAsSame ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "active" /\ phase = "inspectTaken"
    /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = intent /\ caller = "done" /\ reply = "absent"
    /\ named = "absent"
    /\ outcome' = "handedOver" /\ phase' = "terminal" /\ namedVerified' = TRUE /\ cleanup' = "waiting"
    /\ intent' = NoRequest /\ wire' = NoRequest /\ caller' = "idle" /\ reply' = "none" /\ execution' = NoRequest
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

\* Legacy meanings are opaque tokens for the existing readers' meanings.
\* The maxima are representative bounds; code refinement binds them and the
\* opaque meanings to the actual v0.1.0 tables, without reordering those tables.
LegacyReasonMeaning(number) == <<"legacyReason", number>>
LegacyAnswerMeaning(number) == <<"legacyAnswer", number>>
AddedReasons == <<"nameFreed", "copyGone">>
AddedAnswers == <<"copyGone">>
PersistedReason(number) ==
    IF number <= LegacyReasonMax THEN LegacyReasonMeaning(number)
    ELSE <<AddedReasons[number - LegacyReasonMax], 0>>
PersistedAnswer(number) ==
    IF number <= LegacyAnswerMax THEN LegacyAnswerMeaning(number)
    ELSE <<AddedAnswers[number - LegacyAnswerMax], 0>>
LegacyNumbersStayReadable ==
    /\ \A number \in 0..LegacyReasonMax : PersistedReason(number) = LegacyReasonMeaning(number)
    /\ \A number \in 0..LegacyAnswerMax : PersistedAnswer(number) = LegacyAnswerMeaning(number)
NewNumbersFollowOldNumbers ==
    /\ \A offset \in 1..Len(AddedReasons) :
           /\ LegacyReasonMax + offset > LegacyReasonMax
           /\ PersistedReason(LegacyReasonMax + offset) = <<AddedReasons[offset], 0>>
    /\ \A offset \in 1..Len(AddedAnswers) :
           /\ LegacyAnswerMax + offset > LegacyAnswerMax
           /\ PersistedAnswer(LegacyAnswerMax + offset) = <<AddedAnswers[offset], 0>>

Init ==
    /\ outcome = "notStarted" /\ phase = "idle" /\ reason = "none"
    /\ attempt = 0 /\ round = 0 /\ differences = 0
    /\ cleanup = "dormant" /\ cleanupReason = "none" /\ cleanupTry = 0
    /\ intent = NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest /\ caller = "idle" /\ reply = "none"
    /\ hidden = "absent" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ foreignContent = named /\ initialNamed = named
    /\ hiddenVerified = FALSE /\ namedVerified = FALSE /\ publicationVerified = FALSE
    /\ publications = 0 /\ copies = 0 /\ activeCopies = 0
    /\ spool = TRUE /\ keepElapsed = FALSE /\ running = TRUE /\ replayed = FALSE
    /\ execution = NoRequest

\* Start and retry are caller choices; attempts are bounded only for exploration.
Start ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "notStarted"
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ phase' = "inspect" /\ attempt' = 1 /\ round' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reason, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryDelivery ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "failed" /\ attempt < MaxAttempts
    /\ outcome' = "active" /\ reason' = "none" /\ attempt' = attempt + 1
    /\ round' = 1 /\ differences' = 0 /\ hiddenVerified' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = "preclean"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named,
                   foreignContent, initialNamed, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Issue ==
    /\ running /\ intent = NoRequest /\ (outcome = "active" \/ cleanup = "active")
    /\ LET r == CASE phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} -> Request("compareNamed", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "preclean" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "copy" -> Request("copy", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "verify" -> Request("compareHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "discard" -> Request("removeHidden", HiddenName, phase)
                     [] phase = "publish" -> Request("publish", FinalName, phase)
                     [] phase = "retention" -> Request("removeSpool", SpoolName, phase)
       IN intent' = r /\ wire' = r
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Resend ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = NoRequest
    /\ wire' = intent
    /\ replayed' = (replayed \/ (intent.kind = "publish" /\ reply = "ok"))
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The caller adapter executes an identity once, caches its result, and shares
\* an in-flight copy with all repetitions. These are the settled caller rules.
BeginCopy ==
    /\ wire.kind = "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "busy" /\ hidden' = "partial" /\ activeCopies' = 1 /\ copies' = copies + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, reply, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

FinishCopy(result, content) ==
    /\ caller = "busy"
    /\ result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
    /\ content \in IF result = "ok" THEN {"same", "different"} ELSE {"partial"}
    /\ reply' = result /\ hidden' = content
    /\ caller' = "done" /\ activeCopies' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

ExecuteOther(r) ==
    /\ wire # NoRequest /\ wire.kind # "copy" /\ caller = "idle"
    /\ caller' = "done"
    /\ r \in CASE wire.kind = "compareNamed" -> {named, "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "compareHidden" -> {IF hidden = "same" THEN "same" ELSE "different", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "publish" -> PublicationReplies \cup {"folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "removeHidden" -> {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}
                     [] wire.kind = "removeSpool" -> {"ok", "removeFailed"}
    /\ reply' = r
    /\ hidden' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind \in {"publish", "removeHidden"} THEN "absent" ELSE hidden
    /\ named' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hidden ELSE named
    /\ publications' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN publications + 1 ELSE publications
    /\ publicationVerified' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "publish" THEN hiddenVerified ELSE publicationVerified
    /\ spool' = IF r = "ok" /\ wire.kind = "removeSpool" THEN FALSE ELSE spool
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, copies, activeCopies, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = wire

Consume ==
    /\ running /\ intent # NoRequest /\ wire = intent /\ caller = "done"
    /\ intent' = NoRequest /\ wire' = NoRequest /\ caller' = "idle" /\ reply' = "none"
    /\ LET race == RaceReason # "none"
           failed == reply \in {"folderGone", "folderFull"} \/ race
           success == (phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "same") \/ (phase = "publish" /\ reply = "ok")
           conflict == phase \in {"inspect", "inspectTaken"} /\ reply = "different"
           exhausted == phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ differences = MaxDifferences
       IN /\ outcome' = IF phase = "retention" THEN outcome
                         ELSE IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted THEN "failed"
                         ELSE IF success THEN "handedOver" ELSE outcome
          /\ reason' = IF race THEN RaceReason ELSE IF failed THEN reply ELSE IF conflict THEN "nameConflict"
                        ELSE IF exhausted THEN "differentCopies" ELSE reason
          /\ phase' = IF failed \/ conflict \/ exhausted \/ success \/ phase = "retention" THEN "terminal"
                       ELSE CASE phase = "inspect" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "preclean" -> "inspect"
                                 [] phase = "copy" -> "verify"
                                 [] phase = "verify" -> IF reply = "same" THEN "publish" ELSE "discard"
                                 [] phase = "discard" -> "copy"
                                 [] phase = "publish" -> "inspectTaken"
          /\ differences' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "different" THEN differences + 1 ELSE differences
          /\ round' = IF phase = "discard" /\ reply = "ok" /\ ~exhausted THEN round + 1 ELSE round
          /\ hiddenVerified' = IF phase = "verify" /\ reply = "same" THEN TRUE
                                ELSE IF phase \in {"preclean", "discard"} /\ reply = "ok" THEN FALSE
                                ELSE hiddenVerified
          /\ namedVerified' = (namedVerified \/ success)
          /\ cleanup' = IF success THEN "waiting"
                         ELSE IF phase = "retention" THEN IF reply = "ok" THEN "done" ELSE "failed"
                         ELSE cleanup
          /\ cleanupReason' = IF phase = "retention" /\ reply = "removeFailed" THEN "removeFailed" ELSE cleanupReason
    /\ UNCHANGED <<attempt, cleanupTry, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ execution' = NoRequest

BeginRetention ==
    /\ running /\ outcome = "handedOver" /\ cleanup = "waiting" /\ keepElapsed
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupTry' = 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanupReason, intent, wire,
                   caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

RetryCleanup ==
    /\ running /\ cleanup = "failed" /\ cleanupTry < MaxCleanupAttempts
    /\ cleanup' = "active" /\ cleanupReason' = "none" /\ cleanupTry' = cleanupTry + 1 /\ phase' = "retention"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, reason, attempt, round, differences, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified,
                   publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

\* The environment may take the final name even between its comparison and
\* publication. Publication is non-replacing and reports that collision.

    /\ outcome = "active" /\ named = "absent"
    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, initialNamed, hiddenVerified,
                   namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies, activeCopies,
                   spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent,
                   initialNamed, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications,
                   copies, activeCopies, spool, running, replayed>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

    /\ ~running /\ running' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences, cleanup, cleanupReason,
                   cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply, hidden, named, foreignContent, initialNamed,
                   hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified, publications, copies,
                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, replayed>>
    /\ UNCHANGED execution

Wait == UNCHANGED vars

ResendProgress == SF_vars(Resend)

    /\ content \in {"same", "different"}
    /\ named' = content /\ foreignContent' = content /\ initialNamed' = content
    /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, reason, attempt, round, differences,
                   cleanup, cleanupReason, cleanupTry, intent, wire, caller, reply,
                   execution, hidden, hiddenVerified, namedVerified, publicationVerified,
                   publications, copies, activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>

        \/ (\E result \in {"ok", "folderGone", "folderFull"}, content \in {"same", "different", "partial"} : FinishCopy(result, content))

                   activeCopies, spool, keepElapsed, running, replayed>>
